p1_findings.violation: Required SQLite cleanup invariants 4 and 5: cleanup unexpectedly replaces a primary typed safe Action/domain conflict.
p1_findings.fault_setup: Real isolated SQLite v2 file; bound Approved/v5 Run, admitted Pending/v1 Action; authorize with stale expected_action_version=2. Retain a real sqlite3.Connection subclass. Independently inject rollback, in_transaction inspection, or close acknowledgement exception after physical close.
p1_findings.expected: Preserve primary STALE_ACTION_VERSION / HTTP 409 while independently attempting close; record secondary cleanup uncertainty without claiming success.
p1_findings.actual: Normal control returns 409 STALE_ACTION_VERSION; all three secondary fault modes return 503 DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE.
p1_findings.persistent_state: Action Pending/v1; zero grants, attempts, adapter calls, notes and receipts. Complete business rows unchanged. Second writer UPDATE and COMMIT succeeds in every mode while strong reference is retained.
p1_findings.impact: Meaningful CAS/domain conflict is misclassified as a database outage, violating required safe error precedence. No demonstrated lock leak, secret exposure, authorization bypass or external duplicate effect.
p1_findings.smallest_recommended_correction: In the Action transaction helper preserve an active primary typed safe error; keep independent close; safely classify cleanup-only uncertainty and record secondary cleanup failure. Add direct and real-HTTP stale/domain-error plus rollback/inspection/close regressions. This is recommendation only, not implemented.

p2_deferred: Local bearer capability is not production user identity/RBAC or authenticated distinct-approver consent.
Single-owner local SQLite only; no multi-worker HA, distributed locks or production cloud validation.
Downstream scoped idempotency is not universal exactly-once semantics.
No automatic retry/reconciliation; Unknown deliberately sacrifices progress.
Async deadlines are soft; blocking SQLite or arbitrary external effects cannot be forcibly undone.
Static reviewed demo registry is not a generic plugin system; future bindings require separate review.
No live competition adapter, cloud/MCP integration, physical power-loss or hostile-host protection validation.
Driver refusal of physical close can retain a lock despite independent close attempt; not a new avoidable-cleanup P1.
